verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a webhook system (create/list/fetch/update/delete) and event-driven notifications for specific transaction types (ACH returns, wire status, card creation, card declines), supporting real-time event delivery. However, there is no evidence describing a balance object that explicitly reflects holds/pending activity, nor a comprehensive list confirming webhooks fire for every transaction state change across all money-movement types. Missing for 10: explicit balance/hold-and-pending-activity API documentation, and a complete enumerated webhook-event catalog covering all transaction lifecycle states.
